evals.prompt: Where do we start? We're building a soil-moisture drought advisory with a state ag agency.
expectations: Asks at most 4 setup questions (title, phase, ARL, today's need)
Recommends sco-01-designing-for-impact or sco-04-stakeholder-mapping with a one-sentence reason
Prints status block with completed tools, open items, AI-DRAFT count, and a Next recommendation
Does not re-ask information present in the profile
